plain_statement: KM0: AND/OR gates listing two earlier wires each, on N points then N lines, each AND gate with an input reading no line or two reading no point. Assume the normal-form lemma and transposition count for KM0. On a plane of order q let C be KM0, t gates, accepting incident pairs, rejecting inputs of at most k >= 1 lines, no incident pair. Then KM0 point and line circuits, together at most 5t gates, have wires Psi_w, R_p: Psi_w(e_p) or R_p(e_w) per incidence; Psi_w(e_p) only if p is on w, 0 off w; R_p(e_l) only if p is on l, 0 on k lines off p. Conjecture, on paper.
title: If the flag lemma and transposition count hold: on a plane of order q, a sound AND/OR fan-in-two KM0 circuit splits into circuits of at most 5t gates
